boundary: Prototype lowering fragment only. Python process is not a real capability sandbox and could have ambient authority if arbitrary host APIs/imports were exposed. This is not APP-02 PASS, APP-04 PASS, or GENERAL_PURPOSE_GATE PASS. Production design still requires an opaque typed host resource/FFI boundary and sandbox policy.
generated_target: python3 stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer over inherited listening socket
negative_result_from_v1: Embedding a per-run host token hash in generated target code makes generated-code identity capability-instance-dependent and violates deterministic compiler/receipt identity expectations.
semantic_claim: For this bounded HTTP probe, existing G9 record/rule/effect-reference semantics plus a typed host resource-handle adapter suffice; the host can own bind authority and pass only an already-authorized listener handle without embedding capability-instance secrets into generated code.
title: Deterministic ClayCode HTTP lowering with host-owned inherited listener handle
